properties.name: app.ai.max-prompt-length
properties.description: Maximum accepted AI prompt length before any provider call.

properties.name: app.authentication.provider
properties.description: External authentication adapter: noop fails closed; firebase requires explicit Firebase configuration.

properties.name: app.firebase.enabled
properties.description: Creates shared Firebase SDK beans only when explicitly enabled.

properties.name: app.firebase.service-account-key-path
properties.description: Runtime-mounted Firebase service-account resource. Never commit the credential file.

properties.name: app.firebase.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: Firebase SDK connection timeout in milliseconds; must be between 1 and 120000.

properties.name: app.firebase.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Firebase SDK read timeout in milliseconds; must be between 1 and 120000.

properties.name: app.storage.provider
properties.description: Object storage adapter: noop fails closed; firebase uses Google Cloud Storage.

properties.name: app.storage.bucket
properties.description: Bucket used by the explicitly enabled Firebase storage adapter.

properties.name: app.storage.max-file-size
properties.description: Maximum signed-upload content length in bytes.

properties.name: app.storage.signed-url-duration
properties.description: Signed URL lifetime between one second and seven days.

properties.name: app.observability.gcp-project-id
properties.description: Optional Google Cloud project used to qualify trace identifiers in structured logs.
